about: Team-name equivalences used to join Hotspawn fixtures to outside prices, Valve standings and HLTV. Only names proven to denote the same team in the same fixture slot are listed; every entry carries the fixture-level evidence and the URL it was read from. Generic words (Team, Esports, Gaming, GG) and case/punctuation are normalised in code. Entries were compiled and verified by session arena/22be6967 (read 2026-10-15 10:05-10:25 UTC) and are re-used here with their evidence intact; session arena/a6f05f99 re-checked each one against the same official pages on 2026-10-15 22:00-23:00 UTC.
